headlines.text: Wall Street futures rise Wednesday (S&P +0.5%, Nasdaq-100 +0.9%, Dow +0.3%) as Nvidia clears earnings hurdle and traders await Fed minutes and Anthropic's IPO pricing
Target's Q3 comparable sales jump 5.6% (vs. ~3.6% est.) with EPS of $2.65 as turnaround accelerates; shares climb premarket and full-year guidance raised

Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting minutes due out this afternoon (2pm ET), expected to detail the 10-2 vote to hold rates at 3.75%-4%, with Cook and Hammack's dissents favoring a hike underscoring little room for a December cut
Anthropic set to price its IPO Wednesday evening at $70-$78 a share, valuing the AI firm near $1.4 trillion ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT

Nvidia posted fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8B (up 103% YoY, crushing the ~$109B estimate) with EPS of $2.70 and guided Q4 to $130B in interim CEO Colette Kress's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's exit; shares surged nearly 4% after hours
U.S. retail sales growth slowed to 0.2% in October from September's 0.8%, though core sales excluding autos, gas and building materials rose a stronger-than-expected 0.6%
